novenas.title: Novena for my intentions
novenas.about: Nine days of trusting prayer for the things on your heart, as the apostles prayed with Mary for nine days before Pentecost.

days.reflection: Jesus invites us to ask. Bring your intentions to him today without fear.
Mary said yes to God's plan. Ask for the grace to trust his answer, whatever it is.
Hand your worries over to God, and let his peace guard your heart.
Pray with faith. God hears every word.
Ask in the name of Jesus, united with his own prayer to the Father.
Be still. Let a minute of silence be part of your prayer today.
God can bring good out of every situation you are praying about.
Keep praying, and do not lose heart.
Thank God for hearing you, and leave your intentions in his hands.
